bar.name: v1 HTML fixtures and A2UI for the same apps; 300 blind English requests; independent end-to-end attack on stored rows

biggest_gap: Three ways to lose or strand saved data remain: Undo/restore after an option rename leaves rows on the new option (filters read 0), a changed setting default overwrites the user's stored value, and restore(older snapshot) plus one safe edit hides every restored row.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: corpus + requests + COVERAGE.md now in the repo: 237 full of 300, 92.6% of 256 in-scope; critic ran all 300 with random taps and ticks: 0 crashes, 0 error nodes
corpus median 136 stock / 132 planned (142 on full-verdict programs); std-style examples 151/156; 4.98x-5.16x fewer than v1 HTML

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: 492/492 tests; 4,639 prefix checks; fuzzers with fresh seeds: 0 crashes, 0 violations in 40,000 schema edits and 10,367 edits on real rows

acceptance.line: edits never lose or retype saved data while marked safe
acceptance.evidence: 48 name-based chains held (renames, swaps, cycles, drop/re-add, widen, revert); failures: option rename + Undo, setting default overwrite (3000 -> 2500, 42 -> 10), restore(old snapshot) then edit hides rows, load() throws on corrupt history

other_notes: Wrong results: trend/bars over a table plot newest first, so time runs right to left unless the program writes `sort at`; money rounds to cents at every step (EMI off by 2 cents); `desc` leaves empties last although the doc says reversed.

Name constraint: 83% name-clean when every name position is random; leading-space tokens bypass the mask; several expression positions return 'free'; one false refusal; 26 ms median per call is too slow per token without caching.

Learnability: size judged ok (212 keywords, 47 functions, 27 nodes, 15 std) but with redundant spellings to merge; bare-name line needs `text`; table named `card` breaks `list card`; no hints for `else if`, `==`, `+=`, date literals, `+` joins.
